Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that improves your quality of life ] || ---------------- || Rating. Summary. The installation process was systematic and clean. The Essential White color blends well with the interior. Various cleaning modes allow for various situations. Ample interior space. Reason for purchase. I'm a two-person household, but I wanted to reduce the stress of washing dishes, so I was considering purchasing a dishwasher. At first, I wondered if I would use it often, but after using it, I was so satisfied that I wondered why I waited so long to buy it. Installation. I received a call the day after purchase, and they conducted a pre-installation inspection of the space. After carefully checking the installation, separate installers visited again to complete the installation. The separate visits by the construction and installation staff were very systematic, which made me feel confident and safe. Exterior design. The Essential White color creates a very clean exterior. The subtle white tone will blend seamlessly into any kitchen interior. The built-in design adds a sense of order and refinement, making the kitchen feel more organized. User review and modes. I'm very satisfied with the dishwasher itself. For a two-person household, I gather all my lunch and dinner dishes and wash them all at once in the evening. On days when I only ate dinner, I use the top speed mode for a quick wash. The ability to select the mode that best suits the situation allows for flexibility. Late at night, the quiet night mode allows me to run the dishwasher without worrying about noise. In practice, the noise level was just right for everyday use, so it wasn't a problem at all. The variety of modes is a bigger advantage than I expected. Internal space. The top compartment is perfect for storing cutlery and cooking utensils, and the two lower compartments are spacious enough to fit even large pots and steamers. It holds more than I expected, making it incredibly convenient to clean up in one go. For a two-person household, the capacity is ample, so I'm using it without any issues. Comments (English): [ The dishes that were washed look like 'I went to the spa today' ] || ---------------- || I purchased a Samsung Bespoke DW30FB305CW0 6-seater countertop dishwasher with my own money from Coupang. The technician came today to install it and I used it right away! I'm leaving an honest review based on my family of four (I actually used it the same day). My kitchen is small, so I was looking for a countertop dishwasher instead of a built-in one, and I ended up going with this Samsung Bespoke model. The matte white color is beautiful and fingerprint-resistant. The official website claims it can easily handle a meal for a family of four, so I was excited, and it was perfect! The installation process: The technician arrived around 11:00 AM and was done in 20-30 minutes! All I had to do was connect the water supply and drain hoses and plug it in. The technician explained in detail how to use the folding basket, where to place the detergent and conditioner dispensers, and even the auto-open door function. Installation was free, so no worries! Here's my same-day review (based on one meal for a family of four). After dinner for a family of four, I ran the "Standard Wash" + rinsing cycle on all the plates, spoons, chopsticks, and cups I'd left behind. It took about an hour and a half, and the cleaning power is truly amazing. It even removed the rice gruel stains from the kids' bowls, and the greasy frying pan was squeaky clean! The high-temperature, direct-water sterilization guarantees 99.999% sterilization, so there's no need to worry about hygiene, especially when washing baby bottles and lunch boxes. What impressed me most was the hot air drying and automatic door opening. As soon as the washing was done, the door swung open, blasting hot air to dry all the moisture. I took the dishwasher out, and even the insides of the cups and plates were completely dry, fluffy and free of water stains! My previous manual drying dishwasher left me wiping the remaining moisture, but this one is hands-free, a real lifesaver. It's quieter at around 45dB during the wash cycle, so it doesn't interfere with the TV, and the front touch panel is intuitive enough for kids to use. There's also a quick wash (29 minutes) cycle, which is handy for those morning rushes! Water consumption is just right for a meal for four, and its energy rating of 2 keeps your electricity bill low. The downside? When loading a very large wok or several large pots at once, you'll need to adjust it slightly at an angle. However, for a family of four, with their usual eating patterns (breakfast and lunch separately, dinner together), it was mostly fine, and the ability to add extra dishes in the middle is convenient. Even if you combine two meals a day, there's still plenty of room. Conclusion: Highly recommended for a family of four! Since it seats six, it's perfect for finishing a meal, and it significantly reduces dishwashing stress. After getting it installed and using it on the same day, I understand why everyone says you won't regret buying a dishwasher. Coupang Rocket Installation + Same-Day Use Perfect! 200% worth the money. If you're considering a four-person household, go for this model! I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): I've had the Bosch Benchmark (SHP9PCM5N) for a couple of months now, and honestly, it's lived up to the hype.
Comments (English): [ The Benchmark for a Reason ] || ---------------- || I've had the Bosch Benchmark (SHP9PCM5N) for a couple of months now, and honestly, it's lived up to the hype. It's one of those rare "buy once, cry once" purchases that actually feels worth it every time I walk into the kitchen. Here's the breakdown of what actually matters in daily use: The "Is it even on? " Factor The 38 dBA rating isn't just marketing fluff. It is freakishly quiet. Since my kitchen opens right into the living room, this was a huge deal for me. In the past, we had to choose between doing chores and watching a movie because the old dishwasher sounded like a jet taking off. With this one, I've actually walked up to it and double-checked the TimeLight on the floor just to confirm it was actually running. The App is Surprisingly Useful I'm usually a skeptic when it comes to "smart" appliances, but the Home Connect integration is actually legit. Rate Shifting: This is the killer feature. I can set it to auto-schedule around my electric rates so it runs during the cheapest windows. It's satisfying to know I'm saving money on the PGE bill while I sleep without having to manually time anything. Remote Control: Being able to kick off a cycle or check the status from my phone while I'm in another room (or even out of the house) is way more convenient than I expected. No More Drying Dishes by Hand The CrystalDry tech is the real hero here. I was tired of opening the dishwasher and finding "puddles" on top of every Tupperware lid or plastic bowl. Everything—even the plastics—comes out bone-dry. It saves that annoying extra step of having to keep a kitchen towel nearby when you're unloading. The Bottom Line It's a fantastic machine. It cleans everything perfectly, it's dead silent, and the smart scheduling makes it feel like it's working for me rather than the other way around. The only real downside? Now that I have this in the kitchen, I'm constantly eyeing their Benchmark refrigerators. They look incredible, but for now, that's definitely staying on the "maybe when I win the lottery" list.

It's one of those rare "buy once, cry once" purchases that actually feels worth it every time I walk into the kitchen. Here's the breakdown of what actually matters in daily use: The "Is it even on? " Factor The 38 dBA rating isn't just marketing fluff. It is freakishly quiet. Since my kitchen opens right into the living room, this was a huge deal for me. In the past, we had to choose between doing chores and watching a movie because the old dishwasher sounded like a jet taking off. With this one, I've actually walked up to it and double-checked the TimeLight on the floor just to confirm it was actually running. The App is Surprisingly Useful I'm usually a skeptic when it comes to "smart" appliances, but the Home Connect integration is actually legit. Rate Shifting: This is the killer feature. I can set it to auto-schedule around my electric rates so it runs during the cheapest windows. It's satisfying to know I'm saving money on the PGE bill while I sleep without having to manually time anything. Remote Control: Being able to kick off a cycle or check the status from my phone while I'm in another room (or even out of the house) is way more convenient than I expected. No More Drying Dishes by Hand The CrystalDry tech is the real hero here. I was tired of opening the dishwasher and finding "puddles" on top of every Tupperware lid or plastic bowl. Everything—even the plastics—comes out bone-dry. It saves that annoying extra step of having to keep a kitchen towel nearby when you're unloading. The Bottom Line It's a fantastic machine. It cleans everything perfectly, it's dead silent, and the smart scheduling makes it feel like it's working for me rather than the other way around. The only real downside? Now that I have this in the kitchen, I'm constantly eyeing their Benchmark refrigerators. They look incredible, but for now, that's definitely staying on the "maybe when I win the lottery" list.

Comments (English): [ The Benchmark for a Reason ] || ---------------- || I've had the Bosch Benchmark (SHP9PCM5N) for a couple of months now, and honestly, it's lived up to the hype. " Factor. The 38 dBA rating isn't just marketing fluff. It is freakishly quiet. Since my kitchen opens right into the living room, this was a huge deal for me. With this one, I've actually walked up to it and double-checked the TimeLight on the floor just to confirm it was actually running. The App is Surprisingly Useful. I'm usually a skeptic when it comes to "smart" appliances, but the Home Connect integration is actually legit. Rate Shifting: This is the killer feature. I can set it to auto-schedule around my electric rates so it runs during the cheapest windows. It's satisfying to know I'm saving money on the PGE bill while I sleep without having to manually time anything. Remote Control: Being able to kick off a cycle or check the status from my phone while I'm in another room (or even out of the house) is way more convenient than I expected. No More Drying Dishes by Hand. The CrystalDry tech is the real hero here. I was tired of opening the dishwasher and finding "puddles" on top of every Tupperware lid or plastic bowl. Everything—even the plastics—comes out bone-dry. It saves that annoying extra step of having to keep a kitchen towel nearby when you're unloading. The Bottom Line. It's a fantastic machine. It cleans everything perfectly, it's dead silent, and the smart scheduling makes it feel like it's working for me rather than the other way around. The only real downside? Now that I have this in the kitchen, I'm constantly eyeing their Benchmark refrigerators. They look incredible, but for now, that's definitely staying on the "maybe when I win the lottery" list.

" Factor. The 38 dBA rating isn't just marketing fluff. It is freakishly quiet. Since my kitchen opens right into the living room, this was a huge deal for me. In the past, we had to choose between doing chores and watching a movie because the old dishwasher sounded like a jet taking off. With this one, I've actually walked up to it and double-checked the TimeLight on the floor just to confirm it was actually running. The App is Surprisingly Useful. I'm usually a skeptic when it comes to "smart" appliances, but the Home Connect integration is actually legit. Rate Shifting: This is the killer feature. I can set it to auto-schedule around my electric rates so it runs during the cheapest windows. It's satisfying to know I'm saving money on the PGE bill while I sleep without having to manually time anything. Remote Control: Being able to kick off a cycle or check the status from my phone while I'm in another room (or even out of the house) is way more convenient than I expected. No More Drying Dishes by Hand. The CrystalDry tech is the real hero here. I was tired of opening the dishwasher and finding "puddles" on top of every Tupperware lid or plastic bowl. Everything—even the plastics—comes out bone-dry. It saves that annoying extra step of having to keep a kitchen towel nearby when you're unloading. The Bottom Line. It's a fantastic machine. It cleans everything perfectly, it's dead silent, and the smart scheduling makes it feel like it's working for me rather than the other way around. The only real downside? Now that I have this in the kitchen, I'm constantly eyeing their Benchmark refrigerators. They look incredible, but for now, that's definitely staying on the "maybe when I win the lottery" list.

Comments (English): It was supposedly the closest to a Bosch I could get without paying the cost of a Bosch in doing my research. Normal wash takes several hours. I actually had to cancel the wash because it was taking so long. I could have washed 8 loads of dishes by hand in that time. I don't like that you can't just use the sani wash feature by itself. I needed a new dishwasher but wish I hadn't spent so much because it's basically a glorified drying rack at this point.

Comments (English): [ Beware of Bosch and, Unfortunately, of Costco ] || ---------------- || The good: the unity cleans well, and the CrystalDry Technology is a good drying function. The bad: I live alone, and have no children. I use the dishwasher 1-2 times a week. 17 months after purchase the door end cap on the handle broke into two pieces while wiping the exterior. Bosch says it is out of "cosmetic" warranty, despite internet searches saying the door end cap serves a functional purpose by providing access to the dishwasher's interior components, rather than being purely cosmetic. It helps maintain the appliance's performance and efficiency. The part costs about $10. The service call is about $175. Because Bosch says it is out of "cosmetic" warranty neither Bosch nor Costco will pay for all or part of the service call, nor will the All State extended warranty. I will never buy another Bosch product because of this, and am very disappointed that Costco didn't offer to defray all or some of the cost. The moral of the story is neither Bosch nor Costco tell you that this part is known to break (do internet search), and that when it does you will have to pay for the service call and part. I previously had a KitchenAid dishwasher for 15 years and never had a cosmetic issue, as the handle was solid without cheap parts on the side to fall apart. I should have bought another KitchenAid rather than Bosch.

Comments (English): [ Best value dishwasher ] || ---------------- || While decorating, I had a lot of concerns about the dishwasher. LG or Samsung? 12-seater or 14-seater? Sentence (English): I purchased the dishwasher and had it delivered to my home.
Comments (English): [ Very Happy With Our New Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I purchased the dishwasher and had it delivered to my home. I chose to install the machine myself. I would recommend this only for somewhat experienced DIYers as some of the steps were challenging (ex. reconnecting the wiring for the drip pan; hooking up direct wiring). If you self install, I strongly recommend watching the Maytag/Whirlpool videos for your product - these proved to be invaluable and I probably would have not been able to install the product without these resources. The paper installation instructions are not that helpful as the illustrations are not actual photos but instead they are drawings which diminish the usefulness. The steps in the paper manual that are outlined are accurate and you must follow these exactly if you want success. After installation, I was able to run the test cycle successfully and monitored for any leaks (none found). We've been using the dishwasher now for a little over a week and are very impressed with its performance - it cleans really well, looks great, is quiet, easy to use and it seems to handle all kinds of dishes/pans. We're currently experimenting with different cycles and detergents - we were a bit surprised to see that the normal cycle is well over 3 hours but after researching we have learned that this is normal for the newer technology dishwashers. Overall, we are very satisfied with our Maytag dishwasher (so far) and hope that the solid performance continues.

Sentence (English): Washing dishes.
Comments (English): [ I have some free time in the evening. ] || ---------------- || Washing dishes. It might seem like a simple task, but it is back-breaking and tiring. Raising two children means dealing with a large volume of dishes, and the sink is small, so it was always inconvenient. I never even considered buying a dishwasher because there was no space to install one in the sink area, but I discovered freestanding models belatedly and purchased one. Although loading and unloading dishes is a bit of a hassle, I am satisfied because the performance is good and it is convenient. Even items I doubt could be cleaned are washed perfectly. I regret not buying this sooner. It is also great that I can place items on top of it.

I finally ate the cost and tossed it out.

Sentence (English): I buy Bosch solely because of the quality it offers, so I made an easy decision.
Comments (English): [ Bosch series 4 ] || ---------------- || I buy Bosch solely because of the quality it offers, so I made an easy decision. There was no excessive thinking about the brand. I hope it will remain that way in the future. I chose the 45cm wide machine because of space constraints. The machine itself is very beautiful in terms of appearance, with a modern design. Easy to operate. The material is excellent because fingerprints do not remain on the front. As for the interior, the space is very well organized. It fits many more dishes than the previous machine of the same dimensions, of another brand. It is very quiet in operation, which means a lot to me because the apartment is small and I sleep in the living room, which was not the case with the previous machine. I am delighted with the 1-hour program that washes dishes perfectly regardless of the time. I like the fact that when it finishes its work, it turns off by itself. So I don't have to monitor it and listen for a beep. In a word, I am very satisfied.
Comments (Original): [ Bosch serija 4 ] || ---------------- || Bosch kupujem isključivo zbog kvaliteta koji nudi tako da sam se lako odlučila. Nije bilo nekog preteranog razmišljanja oko brenda. Nadam se da će tako ostati i u buduće. Mašinu širine 45cm sam odabrala zbog prostornog ograničenja. Sama mašina je što se tiče izgleda veoma lepa, modernog dizajna. Jednostavna za rukovanje. Materijal je odličan jer ne ostaju otisci prstiju na frontu. Što se tiče unutrašnjosti jako je dobro organizovan prostor. Stane mnogo više sudova nego u prethodnu mašinu istih dimenzija, drugog brenda. Veoma je tiha u radu što mi dosta znači jer je stan mali i spavam u dnevnoj sobi što nije bio slučaj sa prethodnom mašinom. Oduševljena sam programom od 1h koji bez obzira na vreme odlično opere sudove. Dopada mi se to da kada završi svoj rad sama se ugasi, isključi. Tako da ne moram da je pratim i osluškujem zvučni signal. Jednom rečju ja sam prezadovoljna.

Sentence (English): I bought this DW last month after my old Whirlpool gold DW completely stopped working plus it had stopped cleaning properly.
Comments (English): [ new dishwasher review ] || ---------------- || I bought this DW last month after my old Whirlpool gold DW completely stopped working plus it had stopped cleaning properly. I really liked the racks in the old DW but didn't like the small cutlery holder. I also liked the "clips' where you could attach small things like lids to prevent them from going astray. I do like the third rack for more cutlery on my new DW. I wish the racks had more configurations like my old ones, esp on the bottom rack where you could fold one or two of the sections down to accommodate large things like casserole/roast pans. The first rack on the new one doesn't convert at all. The second rack has one section that can fold down but I don't like how it can't properly hold things upright such as soup bowls and sometimes even glasses will fall over! I do like the much larger cutlery holder plus the third rack for extra cutlery ot larger baking utensils. I appreciate that there are 3 cleaning sprayers. The older racks seemed much stronger than the newer ones! The new DW so far cleans well [although i can't stop myself from rinsing dishes before putting them in! The new DW is quieter but takes so much longer for a cycle [likely a much less powerful motor? ]. I am also not keen on the hidden controls although it does give a much sleeker appearance. I just hope this new model lasts a good 20 years like my old one but somehow doubt it due to built-in obsolescence! I wish manufacturers would keep a supply of parts for years to fix older models as it bothers me that we have become such a disposable society!

Sentence (English): We purchased this model and almost immediately had a leak at the top corners of the door.
Comments (English): [ A fix for the leak ] || ---------------- || We purchased this model and almost immediately had a leak at the top corners of the door. We reviewed many reviews and found similar problems.The tell-tale sign is that there is wetness (condensation) on the rubber grommet on the outside of the door. It will accumulate enough to generate a puddle on the floor. I offer here a solution. Purchase 1/16" or 1/8" rubber with adhesive on one side, the width is arbitrary and can be cut to size, but this solution about 1/2" is good. Cut the rubber to a length appropriate to the dampness on the outer rubber strip of the door (like weatherstripping). Place the adhesive side on the stainless steel of the door and presto, the leak goes away. I used 1/8" and the door still closed easily. We had it on the upper right corner, so I used 3 pieces to make 8 inches of vertical, 2 inches of corner and an additional 4 inches of horizontal on the door. The rubber should face toward the main dishwasher when the door closes.There is no way to tell where the weakness in the surrounding weatherstripping will be, so it may be needed to make the extra rubber seal go the entire width and height of the door.

It will accumulate enough to generate a puddle on the floor. I offer here a solution. Purchase 1/16' or 1/8' rubber with adhesive on one side, the width is arbitrary and can be cut to size, but this solution about 1/2' is good. Cut the rubber to a length appropriate to the dampness on the outer rubber strip of the door (like weatherstripping). Sentence (English): This was a replacement for an older Whirlpool unit.
Comments (English): [ Good product, poor installation experience ] || ---------------- || This was a replacement for an older Whirlpool unit. The Bosch model is much quieter than my old unit but there are some things I definitely think could be better. First, the open/close latch is VERY cheap feeling. Made of plastic that I question will last long with regular use. Second the installation manual that comes with it is too generic and lacks some details for the 100 model in favor of the higher models. I would say do not bother with the squeeze clamps included. Get screw type hose clamps for a better leak less fit. The Bosch couldn't be mounted from the top like my old one due to a granite counter and using the side mount set up meant drilling through the inside of adjacent cabinets. Not ideal. Lastly the elbow needed for the water supply is apparently not a common size. And the connection is at the FRONT of the unit meaning a longer and less easy run for the hose than if it were at the rear like most are. Save yourself some time and get the connector in my photo. Available near the braided hoses used for sinks at Lowes. Works perfect.

Get screw type hose clamps for a better leak less fit. The Bosch couldn't be mounted from the top like my old one due to a granite counter and using the side mount set up meant drilling through the inside of adjacent cabinets. Not ideal. Lastly the elbow needed for the water supply is apparently not a common size. And the connection is at the FRONT of the unit meaning a longer and less easy run for the hose than if it were at the rear like most are. Save yourself some time and get the connector in my photo. Available near the braided hoses used for sinks at Lowes. Works perfect.

Sentence (English): I had an entry level Bosch dishwasher for about 10 years and when it died, I thought I would replace it with something quiet and with more features.
Comments (English): [ Waste of Money! ] || ---------------- || I had an entry level Bosch dishwasher for about 10 years and when it died, I thought I would replace it with something quiet and with more features. I read the numerous five star reviews for this Samsung dishwasher and thought I was making a good choice and getting a good price with the discounted price. I cannot stress enough what a piece of garbage this product it. First, it was the most challenging dishwasher to load. While it has three racks, the layout and use of those racks was mind boggling. It was not intuitive to use this at all. The other downside was that, once I'd played Jenga and loaded what I could into this dishwasher, it did a mediocre job - at best - at delivering clean and dry dishes. Multiple plates, bowls, and coffee cups would emerge from the wash cycle with remnants still attached. My entry level Bosch, while noisy, did an efficacious job of cleaning dishes. I did not care for the door popping open as part of the drying process and there is no way to override that in the app or the unit itself. So whatever is above this dishwasher will be getting a steaming and there's no way around that unless you manually close the door after it's automatically opened upon completion of a wash cycle. Apart from the horrible layout that makes loading dishes a challenge and the substandard cleaning and drying, the other downside was that the unit broke after only a few months. Something responsible for directing the flow of steam in the drying process snapped off the interior wall of the dishwasher last night and I spent and hour trying to reattach it but to no avail. This is not a well built or solid feeling essential appliance. I did not care for anything about this unit. Caveat emptor.

Comments (English): [ new dishwasher review ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I bought this DW last month after my old Whirlpool gold DW completely stopped working plus it had stopped cleaning properly. I really liked the racks in the old DW but didn't like the small cutlery holder. I did like the removable large utensil holder, and the fold down racks on the second rack, esp for holding wine glasses in their place. I also liked the "clips' where you could attach small things like lids to prevent them from going astray. I do like the third rack for more cutlery on my new DW. I wish the racks had more configurations like my old ones, esp on the bottom rack where you could fold one or two of the sections down to accommodate large things like casserole/roast pans. The first rack on the new one doesn't convert at all. The second rack has one section that can fold down but I don't like how it can't properly hold things upright such as soup bowls and sometimes even glasses will fall over! I do like the much larger cutlery holder plus the third rack for extra cutlery ot larger baking utensils. I appreciate that there are 3 cleaning sprayers. The older racks seemed much stronger than the newer ones! The new DW so far cleans well [although i can't stop myself from rinsing dishes before putting them in! The new DW is quieter but takes so much longer for a cycle [likely a much less powerful motor? ]. I am also not keen on the hidden controls although it does give a much sleeker appearance. I just hope this new model lasts a good 20 years like my old one but somehow doubt it due to built-in obsolescence! I wish manufacturers would keep a supply of parts for years to fix older models as it bothers me that we have become such a disposable society!

Sentence (English): I recently purchased and installed the My Dear 6-place setting dishwasher at home from Coupang (bought with my own money).
Comments (English): [ My Dear 6-Person Dishwasher, Good for a Family of 3 ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased and installed the My Dear 6-place setting dishwasher at home from Coupang (bought with my own money). Usually, dishes would pile up after every family meal, which was quite a burden, but since installing it, my lifestyle has definitely changed! I have set it up in a corner of the kitchen and am using it. The size isn't as bulky as I thought, and the capacity is just right for a family of 3 to 4, so it is very practical! At first, I was curious about water usage and cleaning power, but after using it myself, I found that even greasy dishes and pots are cleaned thoroughly, so I hardly do any hand washing anymore. In particular, since I can just put all the dishes in at once after dinner and press a button, I can use that time to do other housework or take a short break, which gives me more free time :). The frequency of dishwashing has decreased noticeably, so I don't have to stand in front of the sink several times a day, which has lessened the strain on my back (this is the biggest advantage!). The operation isn't complicated, so my parents learned it quickly, and the noise isn't excessive, so even running it at night... It didn't bother me much at all. It was also convenient that the dishes came out nice and dry after the drying cycle, allowing me to store them immediately! I'm less worried about water stains, and since my hands don't stay in the water for long, I feel like my hands are less dry in the winter. These days, naturally putting dishes in the dishwasher after meals has become a daily routine. As the time and energy I used to spend on washing dishes have decreased, the atmosphere in the house feels much more relaxed. I never imagined that a single appliance that lightens the burden of kitchen work could bring about such a big change! I think I will continue to use it well. Thank you for reading until the end. Comments (English): [ it is plagued with bad manufacturing and design failures, errors (especially the E15 flooding you will 100% get) ] || ---------------- || I am updating by first review to be clear what all the problems are - and they are all real. This dishwasher gets positive reviews initially. But after just a few months you see the real errors. All you have to do is look at a couple thinks. first - look at the E15, E23, E24 errors that prevent you from using it (you cannot use it when these errors are present). These are flooding errors. (look them up - most, if not all, of their machines have these errors. They do have a work around : 1) you open the door and wait two weeks for it to dry out. 2) You pull it all the way out, tilt it forward (you will do this ever week) to drain the water. But eventually the E15 moves into the more serious E23/24 errors. tilting (after you pull it our from the wall) and leaving to dry stop working. YOU WILL run into that error - i have yet to find someone who owns this 800 series did not. the second worst thing is their filtering and grinding. there is a filter and a grinding. the first is first, the grinder is second. NEITHER work well at all. after 3 months of owning this dishwasher - this was the second MOST common error. I could NOT figure out the problem so called the repair man who looked at it and told me the most common error with the Bosch (right away - not years later - right away) was the flood and the poor filtering. the piece that drains to your garbage disposal or drain (you see the top above the sink with a stainless steel cap where the dishwasher water drains) clogs and everything stops working because once that is clogged - the dishwasher cannot drain. the repair mand TOLD me what it was. he pulled that drain piece apart and sure enough - there was a half toothpick stuck in it. a TOOTHPICK got past the filter and the grinder - then plugged the drain line. after that was removed - it worked again. Until the following week. I make sure dishes are rinsed before putting them in the washer. BUT on occasion lemon seeds find their way into the machine - WHERE THE FILTER should be catching them or the grinder would be grinding them. NEITHER works. You will always be pulling this drain line out to get it unclogged. it's horrible design. I finally, after 5 years pulled this horribly designed machine out and put a different brand back into the wall. bosch gets positive reviews - it's quiet, dishes are clean. i. it's the worst thing i on which i ever spent money. There is no drying. they say they have it - it's simply heating the water to really high heat during last rinse then letting it steam off. you dishes are always wet. it's NOT cheaper for pge as they say - at all. it's a lot of corner cutting and bad design in my opinion. This week i finally pulled that dish rack out (i was hand washing everything and using it as a dish rack). YOU have been warned. Just look up how common those flood errors are. LOOK up how often people are pulling the drain apart to get the dishwasher to drain - because the filter grinder sucks. it fails. Look up how lame their fake energy saving drying system fails. (it's not saving anything - it's just an excuse to not at those parts and charge you a lot of money - while convincing you it is good for you - it's not). Every week for 5 years i was fighting to get this toy to work. I finally ate the cost and tossed it out.

Sentence (English): I was really worried about plumbing and leaks because my house is built on a block, so I really debated buying a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I was really worried about plumbing and leaks because my house is built on a block, so I really debated buying a dishwasher. Furthermore, my back hurts, so bending over the sink every time to wash dishes was incredibly tiring. So, I looked primarily at countertop models instead of built-in ones. An important feature I looked for in a dishwasher was the auto-open door after each wash, and I heard this feature is essential for drying dishes. I compared several brands and even found some cheaper ones, but ultimately chose Samsung. It had a relatively spacious interior and a clean design that didn't detract from my kitchen decor. I also liked the powerful wash cycle and extra rinse function. It even accommodates a decent-sized frying pan, making it very versatile. A tip: don't pack dishes too tightly, leaving a little space between them for better cleaning performance. I don't do a separate pre-wash; I just run it on the powerful wash + extra rinse cycle. It cleans thoroughly, leaving almost no grease or rice residue.

Sentence (English): I was the only one without a dishwasher for my family, so I looked around and bought one.
Comments (English): I was the only one without a dishwasher for my family, so I looked around and bought one. I looked for a 3-person dishwasher that's perfect for small spaces. I chose this one because it has an automatic door open function and UV sterilization. After looking into it, I found that it's identical to the SK Magic product. I was worried the 3-person model would be too small, but it's actually about 60% the size of the 6-person model. Depending on the size, it's larger than I thought, even allowing me to wash pots. I installed it and ran it about three times, but it was as noisy as a washing machine, so I think it'd be a nuisance to run it at night. I tried various items like a tumbler, ice tray, dishes, and cutlery holder, and the results were all excellent, so I'm very satisfied. It takes longer than I expected to fill it with water before use, but it's worth it as a dishwasher replacement. Each cycle takes about two hours, but it's incredibly convenient because there's nothing to do during that time.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is very nice but the silverware compartment is a terrible design.
Comments (English): [ So far so good for cleaning, except…. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is very nice but the silverware compartment is a terrible design. I previously had the Thermador sapphire series and I decided to purchase a Bosch this time. For silverware, there are only three sections (bet short and fills up quickly) and the flip separator is unusable for my silverware. I have average silverware handles, but they are too wide to fit through the grid. And this compartment is in the side, but fits half way back so it is not convenient to quickly pop in more silverware. I bought this dishwasher in a rush and based on reviews and probably should have opened it up inside the store because now that I look, none of the online photos show the silverware compartment. Also, the entire bottom rack "prongs" are slanted - making it difficult for pots and pans and casseroles. Of course it washes good, but the design is lacking.

Sentence (English): 1) LG Induction (White Glass) Review.
Comments (English): 1) LG Induction (White Glass) Review. What I Liked. Kitchen Interior Finish: The white top matches the color of the tiles and countertop, making the appliance look like furniture. This is especially effective when the top is minimal, as shown in the photo. Difficulty in Cleaning the Top: Unlike gas ranges, which require disassembling the burner and digging into grease, the one-touch wipe design makes maintenance easy. The touch panel is located on the front: Easy to reach while cooking (on the front bar), making it easy to use. ThinQ Integration (Visible): The Wi-Fi/ThinQ indicator allows you to check the device's status and sync some settings (range may vary by model). Cons: White glass doesn't "invisible," but rather "visible." Oil splatters are less noticeable, but water marks and matte stains can sometimes remain (remedy with a rinse). Check pot/pan compatibility: Cookware with weak magnetic bases may not heat up or cause malfunctions. Fan noise/relay noise: Fan noise/clicking noise at high power is often normal. Useful tips (only those that are noticeable). Final cleaning routine: After cooking, wipe with a damp cloth, then a dry cloth. This significantly reduces water stains. Remove moisture from the bottom before heating: If you place a pot on a wet bottom, it's easy for stains/heat marks to form. Preventing scratches on the cooktop: Be careful with rough cast iron or pans with peeling coatings (lift, don't push). 2) LG built-in dishwasher (top control, ThinQ) review. The controls are hidden at the top, so when the door is closed, the front is incredibly clean (making the kitchen surface cleaner). Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. Built-in design improves accessibility: The rinse cycle is right next to/under the sink, making the kitchen look more organized. The mode selection is intuitive: Auto/Powerful/Quiet/Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying/Scheduling/Rinse. Normally, Auto, Powerful for oily items, Quiet at night, and Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying for hygiene/baby tableware. This is how it works. Energy efficiency rating verified: Long-term usage costs and electricity bills are also highly satisfying. Some drawbacks: Plastic dryers have limitations: They often leave behind moisture (due to the material's characteristics). Loading determines results: "Instantly put in, instantly come out" is the truth with dishwashers (see tips below). Filter/door bottom maintenance is necessary: Develop a weekly habit and odor/performance issues will virtually disappear. Loading/maintenance tips for significantly improved results: Stack dishes upright to create a "water path": Overlapping dishes will require less cleaning. Angle concave dishes to prevent water pooling: This is especially important for cups and lids. Use just the right amount of detergent: Overloading can actually cause residue and slipperiness. Filter cleaning: At least once a week (lightly rinse), more often if you have a lot of oily items. Drying finish: After the machine is finished, leave the door slightly open for 10 minutes (if possible) to allow the residual heat to drain, which will significantly improve drying.
Comments (Original): 1) LG 인덕션(화이트 글라스) 리뷰좋았던 점주방 인테리어 완성도: 화이트 상판이 상부 타일/상판 색이랑 톤이 맞아서 “가전이 가구처럼” 보여요. 특히 사진처럼 상부가 미니멀하면 효과가 큼.상판 청소 난이도↓: 가스레인지처럼 버너 분해/기름때 파고드는 구조가 아니라, 한 번에 쓱 닦이는 타입이라 관리가 편함.터치 패널이 전면: 조리하면서 손이 닿기 쉬운 위치(전면 바)라 사용성이 좋아요.ThinQ 연동(보임): Wi-Fi/ThinQ 표기가 있어, 기기 상태 확인/일부 설정 연동이 가능한 쪽(모델별 범위 차이 있음).아쉬울 수 있는 점화이트 글라스는 얼룩이 ‘안 보이는 게 아니라 다르게 보임’: 기름 튐은 덜 티나도 물자국/무광 얼룩이 남을 때가 있어요(헹주로 마감하면 해결).냄비/팬 호환 체크 필요: 바닥 자성이 약한 조리도구는 화력이 안 나오거나 오류가 날 수 있음.팬 소음/릴레이 소리: 고출력에서 “팬 도는 소리/딸깍” 소리는 정상 범주인 경우가 많아요.잘 쓰는 팁(체감 큰 것만)마감 청소 루틴: 조리 끝나면 물기 → 마른걸레 순서로 한 번씩. 물자국이 확 줄어요.가열 전 바닥 물기 제거: 냄비 바닥이 젖은 채로 올리면 얼룩/열자국이 생기기 쉬움.상판 긁힘 방지: 바닥 거친 주물/코팅 벗겨진 팬은 조심(밀지 말고 들어서 이동).2) LG 빌트인 식기세척기(상단 컨트롤, ThinQ) 리뷰사진상 컨트롤이 상단에 숨겨지는 타입이라 문 닫으면 전면이 정말 깔끔합니다(주방 ‘면’이 깨끗해짐).좋았던 점설거지 시간/정신적 피로가 크게 줄어듦: 이사 후 새 가전에서 체감효과 1~2순위가 보통 식세기예요.빌트인이라 동선이 좋아짐: 싱크 바로 옆/아래에서 “헹굼→투입→끝”이 되니 주방이 정돈돼 보여요.모드 선택이 직관적(보임): 자동/강력/조용/살균/고온건조/예약/헹굼류가 보이는데,평소엔 자동,기름기 많으면 강력,밤엔 조용,위생/도마·유아식기 느낌이면 살균/고온건조이런 식으로 쓰면 됩니다.에너지효율 1등급 스티커 확인됨: 장기 사용 비용/전기요금 면에서도 심리적 만족이 큼.아쉬울 수 있는 점플라스틱 건조는 한계: 젖어 남는 경우가 많아요(재질 특성).적재가 결과를 좌우: “대충 넣으면 대충 나온다”가 식세기 진리입니다. (팁 아래 참고)필터/도어 하단 관리 필요: 주 1회만 습관 들이면 냄새/성능 이슈가 거의 사라져요.결과 확 좋아지는 적재/관리 팁그릇은 ‘물길’이 생기게 세워 넣기: 겹치면 그 부분만 덜 닦입니다.오목한 그릇은 물 고이지 않게 각도 주기: 컵/뚜껑류가 특히 중요.세제는 “많이”가 아니라 “맞게”: 과다 투입하면 오히려 잔여물/미끌거림이 생길 수 있어요.필터 청소: 최소 주 1회(가볍게 헹굼). 기름진 메뉴가 많으면 더 자주.건조 마무리: 끝나고 10분 뒤 문을 살짝 열어두면(가능한 구조라면) 잔열로 건조가 확 좋아집니다.

This is especially effective when the top is minimal, as shown in the photo. Difficulty in Cleaning the Top: Unlike gas ranges, which require disassembling the burner and digging into grease, the one-touch wipe design makes maintenance easy. The touch panel is located on the front: Easy to reach while cooking (on the front bar), making it easy to use. ThinQ Integration (Visible): The Wi-Fi/ThinQ indicator allows you to check the device's status and sync some settings (range may vary by model). Cons: White glass doesn't "invisible," but rather "visible." Oil splatters are less noticeable, but water marks and matte stains can sometimes remain (remedy with a rinse). Useful tips (only those that are noticeable). Final cleaning routine: After cooking, wipe with a damp cloth, then a dry cloth. This significantly reduces water stains. Remove moisture from the bottom before heating: If you place a pot on a wet bottom, it's easy for stains/heat marks to form. Preventing scratches on the cooktop: Be careful with rough cast iron or pans with peeling coatings (lift, don't push). 2) LG built-in dishwasher (top control, ThinQ) review. The controls are hidden at the top, so when the door is closed, the front is incredibly clean (making the kitchen surface cleaner). Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. Built-in design improves accessibility: The rinse cycle is right next to/under the sink, making the kitchen look more organized. The mode selection is intuitive: Auto/Powerful/Quiet/Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying/Scheduling/Rinse. Normally, Auto, Powerful for oily items, Quiet at night, and Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying for hygiene/baby tableware. This is how it works. Energy efficiency rating verified: Long-term usage costs and electricity bills are also highly satisfying. Some drawbacks: Plastic dryers have limitations: They often leave behind moisture (due to the material's characteristics). Loading determines results: "Instantly put in, instantly come out" is the truth with dishwashers (see tips below). Filter/door bottom maintenance is necessary: Develop a weekly habit and odor/performance issues will virtually disappear. Loading/maintenance tips for significantly improved results: Stack dishes upright to create a "water path": Overlapping dishes will require less cleaning. Angle concave dishes to prevent water pooling: This is especially important for cups and lids. Use just the right amount of detergent: Overloading can actually cause residue and slipperiness. Filter cleaning: At least once a week (lightly rinse), more often if you have a lot of oily items. Drying finish: After the machine is finished, leave the door slightly open for 10 minutes (if possible) to allow the residual heat to drain, which will significantly improve drying.
Comments (Original): 1) LG 인덕션(화이트 글라스) 리뷰좋았던 점주방 인테리어 완성도: 화이트 상판이 상부 타일/상판 색이랑 톤이 맞아서 “가전이 가구처럼” 보여요. 특히 사진처럼 상부가 미니멀하면 효과가 큼.상판 청소 난이도↓: 가스레인지처럼 버너 분해/기름때 파고드는 구조가 아니라, 한 번에 쓱 닦이는 타입이라 관리가 편함.터치 패널이 전면: 조리하면서 손이 닿기 쉬운 위치(전면 바)라 사용성이 좋아요.ThinQ 연동(보임): Wi-Fi/ThinQ 표기가 있어, 기기 상태 확인/일부 설정 연동이 가능한 쪽(모델별 범위 차이 있음).아쉬울 수 있는 점화이트 글라스는 얼룩이 ‘안 보이는 게 아니라 다르게 보임’: 기름 튐은 덜 티나도 물자국/무광 얼룩이 남을 때가 있어요(헹주로 마감하면 해결).냄비/팬 호환 체크 필요: 바닥 자성이 약한 조리도구는 화력이 안 나오거나 오류가 날 수 있음.팬 소음/릴레이 소리: 고출력에서 “팬 도는 소리/딸깍” 소리는 정상 범주인 경우가 많아요.잘 쓰는 팁(체감 큰 것만)마감 청소 루틴: 조리 끝나면 물기 → 마른걸레 순서로 한 번씩. 물자국이 확 줄어요.가열 전 바닥 물기 제거: 냄비 바닥이 젖은 채로 올리면 얼룩/열자국이 생기기 쉬움.상판 긁힘 방지: 바닥 거친 주물/코팅 벗겨진 팬은 조심(밀지 말고 들어서 이동).2) LG 빌트인 식기세척기(상단 컨트롤, ThinQ) 리뷰사진상 컨트롤이 상단에 숨겨지는 타입이라 문 닫으면 전면이 정말 깔끔합니다(주방 ‘면’이 깨끗해짐).좋았던 점설거지 시간/정신적 피로가 크게 줄어듦: 이사 후 새 가전에서 체감효과 1~2순위가 보통 식세기예요.빌트인이라 동선이 좋아짐: 싱크 바로 옆/아래에서 “헹굼→투입→끝”이 되니 주방이 정돈돼 보여요.모드 선택이 직관적(보임): 자동/강력/조용/살균/고온건조/예약/헹굼류가 보이는데,평소엔 자동,기름기 많으면 강력,밤엔 조용,위생/도마·유아식기 느낌이면 살균/고온건조이런 식으로 쓰면 됩니다.에너지효율 1등급 스티커 확인됨: 장기 사용 비용/전기요금 면에서도 심리적 만족이 큼.아쉬울 수 있는 점플라스틱 건조는 한계: 젖어 남는 경우가 많아요(재질 특성).적재가 결과를 좌우: “대충 넣으면 대충 나온다”가 식세기 진리입니다. (팁 아래 참고)필터/도어 하단 관리 필요: 주 1회만 습관 들이면 냄새/성능 이슈가 거의 사라져요.결과 확 좋아지는 적재/관리 팁그릇은 ‘물길’이 생기게 세워 넣기: 겹치면 그 부분만 덜 닦입니다.오목한 그릇은 물 고이지 않게 각도 주기: 컵/뚜껑류가 특히 중요.세제는 “많이”가 아니라 “맞게”: 과다 투입하면 오히려 잔여물/미끌거림이 생길 수 있어요.필터 청소: 최소 주 1회(가볍게 헹굼). 기름진 메뉴가 많으면 더 자주.건조 마무리: 끝나고 10분 뒤 문을 살짝 열어두면(가능한 구조라면) 잔열로 건조가 확 좋아집니다.

Comments (English): 1) LG Induction (White Glass) Review. What I Liked. Kitchen Interior Finish: The white top matches the color of the tiles and countertop, making the appliance look like furniture. Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. This is especially effective when the top is minimal, as shown in the photo. Difficulty in Cleaning the Top: Unlike gas ranges, which require disassembling the burner and digging into grease, the one-touch wipe design makes maintenance easy. The touch panel is located on the front: Easy to reach while cooking (on the front bar), making it easy to use. ThinQ Integration (Visible): The Wi-Fi/ThinQ indicator allows you to check the device's status and sync some settings (range may vary by model). Cons: White glass doesn't "invisible," but rather "visible." Oil splatters are less noticeable, but water marks and matte stains can sometimes remain (remedy with a rinse). Check pot/pan compatibility: Cookware with weak magnetic bases may not heat up or cause malfunctions. Fan noise/relay noise: Fan noise/clicking noise at high power is often normal. Useful tips (only those that are noticeable). Final cleaning routine: After cooking, wipe with a damp cloth, then a dry cloth. This significantly reduces water stains. Remove moisture from the bottom before heating: If you place a pot on a wet bottom, it's easy for stains/heat marks to form. Preventing scratches on the cooktop: Be careful with rough cast iron or pans with peeling coatings (lift, don't push). 2) LG built-in dishwasher (top control, ThinQ) review. The controls are hidden at the top, so when the door is closed, the front is incredibly clean (making the kitchen surface cleaner). Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. Built-in design improves accessibility: The rinse cycle is right next to/under the sink, making the kitchen look more organized. The mode selection is intuitive: Auto/Powerful/Quiet/Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying/Scheduling/Rinse. Normally, Auto, Powerful for oily items, Quiet at night, and Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying for hygiene/baby tableware. This is how it works. Energy efficiency rating verified: Long-term usage costs and electricity bills are also highly satisfying. Some drawbacks: Plastic dryers have limitations: They often leave behind moisture (due to the material's characteristics). Loading determines results: "Instantly put in, instantly come out" is the truth with dishwashers (see tips below). Filter/door bottom maintenance is necessary: Develop a weekly habit and odor/performance issues will virtually disappear. Loading/maintenance tips for significantly improved results: Stack dishes upright to create a "water path": Overlapping dishes will require less cleaning. Angle concave dishes to prevent water pooling: This is especially important for cups and lids. Use just the right amount of detergent: Overloading can actually cause residue and slipperiness. Filter cleaning: At least once a week (lightly rinse), more often if you have a lot of oily items. Drying finish: After the machine is finished, leave the door slightly open for 10 minutes (if possible) to allow the residual heat to drain, which will significantly improve drying.
Comments (Original): 1) LG 인덕션(화이트 글라스) 리뷰좋았던 점주방 인테리어 완성도: 화이트 상판이 상부 타일/상판 색이랑 톤이 맞아서 “가전이 가구처럼” 보여요. 특히 사진처럼 상부가 미니멀하면 효과가 큼.상판 청소 난이도↓: 가스레인지처럼 버너 분해/기름때 파고드는 구조가 아니라, 한 번에 쓱 닦이는 타입이라 관리가 편함.터치 패널이 전면: 조리하면서 손이 닿기 쉬운 위치(전면 바)라 사용성이 좋아요.ThinQ 연동(보임): Wi-Fi/ThinQ 표기가 있어, 기기 상태 확인/일부 설정 연동이 가능한 쪽(모델별 범위 차이 있음).아쉬울 수 있는 점화이트 글라스는 얼룩이 ‘안 보이는 게 아니라 다르게 보임’: 기름 튐은 덜 티나도 물자국/무광 얼룩이 남을 때가 있어요(헹주로 마감하면 해결).냄비/팬 호환 체크 필요: 바닥 자성이 약한 조리도구는 화력이 안 나오거나 오류가 날 수 있음.팬 소음/릴레이 소리: 고출력에서 “팬 도는 소리/딸깍” 소리는 정상 범주인 경우가 많아요.잘 쓰는 팁(체감 큰 것만)마감 청소 루틴: 조리 끝나면 물기 → 마른걸레 순서로 한 번씩. 물자국이 확 줄어요.가열 전 바닥 물기 제거: 냄비 바닥이 젖은 채로 올리면 얼룩/열자국이 생기기 쉬움.상판 긁힘 방지: 바닥 거친 주물/코팅 벗겨진 팬은 조심(밀지 말고 들어서 이동).2) LG 빌트인 식기세척기(상단 컨트롤, ThinQ) 리뷰사진상 컨트롤이 상단에 숨겨지는 타입이라 문 닫으면 전면이 정말 깔끔합니다(주방 ‘면’이 깨끗해짐).좋았던 점설거지 시간/정신적 피로가 크게 줄어듦: 이사 후 새 가전에서 체감효과 1~2순위가 보통 식세기예요.빌트인이라 동선이 좋아짐: 싱크 바로 옆/아래에서 “헹굼→투입→끝”이 되니 주방이 정돈돼 보여요.모드 선택이 직관적(보임): 자동/강력/조용/살균/고온건조/예약/헹굼류가 보이는데,평소엔 자동,기름기 많으면 강력,밤엔 조용,위생/도마·유아식기 느낌이면 살균/고온건조이런 식으로 쓰면 됩니다.에너지효율 1등급 스티커 확인됨: 장기 사용 비용/전기요금 면에서도 심리적 만족이 큼.아쉬울 수 있는 점플라스틱 건조는 한계: 젖어 남는 경우가 많아요(재질 특성).적재가 결과를 좌우: “대충 넣으면 대충 나온다”가 식세기 진리입니다. (팁 아래 참고)필터/도어 하단 관리 필요: 주 1회만 습관 들이면 냄새/성능 이슈가 거의 사라져요.결과 확 좋아지는 적재/관리 팁그릇은 ‘물길’이 생기게 세워 넣기: 겹치면 그 부분만 덜 닦입니다.오목한 그릇은 물 고이지 않게 각도 주기: 컵/뚜껑류가 특히 중요.세제는 “많이”가 아니라 “맞게”: 과다 투입하면 오히려 잔여물/미끌거림이 생길 수 있어요.필터 청소: 최소 주 1회(가볍게 헹굼). 기름진 메뉴가 많으면 더 자주.건조 마무리: 끝나고 10분 뒤 문을 살짝 열어두면(가능한 구조라면) 잔열로 건조가 확 좋아집니다.

This is especially effective when the top is minimal, as shown in the photo. Difficulty in Cleaning the Top: Unlike gas ranges, which require disassembling the burner and digging into grease, the one-touch wipe design makes maintenance easy. The touch panel is located on the front: Easy to reach while cooking (on the front bar), making it easy to use. ThinQ Integration (Visible): The Wi-Fi/ThinQ indicator allows you to check the device's status and sync some settings (range may vary by model). Cons: White glass doesn't "invisible," but rather "visible." Oil splatters are less noticeable, but water marks and matte stains can sometimes remain (remedy with a rinse). Check pot/pan compatibility: Cookware with weak magnetic bases may not heat up or cause malfunctions. Fan noise/relay noise: Fan noise/clicking noise at high power is often normal. Useful tips (only those that are noticeable). Final cleaning routine: After cooking, wipe with a damp cloth, then a dry cloth. This significantly reduces water stains. Remove moisture from the bottom before heating: If you place a pot on a wet bottom, it's easy for stains/heat marks to form. Preventing scratches on the cooktop: Be careful with rough cast iron or pans with peeling coatings (lift, don't push). 2) LG built-in dishwasher (top control, ThinQ) review. The controls are hidden at the top, so when the door is closed, the front is incredibly clean (making the kitchen surface cleaner). Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. Built-in design improves accessibility: The rinse cycle is right next to/under the sink, making the kitchen look more organized. The mode selection is intuitive: Auto/Powerful/Quiet/Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying/Scheduling/Rinse. Normally, Auto, Powerful for oily items, Quiet at night, and Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying for hygiene/baby tableware. This is how it works. Energy efficiency rating verified: Long-term usage costs and electricity bills are also highly satisfying. Some drawbacks: Plastic dryers have limitations: They often leave behind moisture (due to the material's characteristics). Loading determines results: "Instantly put in, instantly come out" is the truth with dishwashers (see tips below). Filter/door bottom maintenance is necessary: Develop a weekly habit and odor/performance issues will virtually disappear. Loading/maintenance tips for significantly improved results: Stack dishes upright to create a "water path": Overlapping dishes will require less cleaning. Angle concave dishes to prevent water pooling: This is especially important for cups and lids. Use just the right amount of detergent: Overloading can actually cause residue and slipperiness. Filter cleaning: At least once a week (lightly rinse), more often if you have a lot of oily items. Drying finish: After the machine is finished, leave the door slightly open for 10 minutes (if possible) to allow the residual heat to drain, which will significantly improve drying.
Comments (Original): 1) LG 인덕션(화이트 글라스) 리뷰좋았던 점주방 인테리어 완성도: 화이트 상판이 상부 타일/상판 색이랑 톤이 맞아서 “가전이 가구처럼” 보여요. 특히 사진처럼 상부가 미니멀하면 효과가 큼.상판 청소 난이도↓: 가스레인지처럼 버너 분해/기름때 파고드는 구조가 아니라, 한 번에 쓱 닦이는 타입이라 관리가 편함.터치 패널이 전면: 조리하면서 손이 닿기 쉬운 위치(전면 바)라 사용성이 좋아요.ThinQ 연동(보임): Wi-Fi/ThinQ 표기가 있어, 기기 상태 확인/일부 설정 연동이 가능한 쪽(모델별 범위 차이 있음).아쉬울 수 있는 점화이트 글라스는 얼룩이 ‘안 보이는 게 아니라 다르게 보임’: 기름 튐은 덜 티나도 물자국/무광 얼룩이 남을 때가 있어요(헹주로 마감하면 해결).냄비/팬 호환 체크 필요: 바닥 자성이 약한 조리도구는 화력이 안 나오거나 오류가 날 수 있음.팬 소음/릴레이 소리: 고출력에서 “팬 도는 소리/딸깍” 소리는 정상 범주인 경우가 많아요.잘 쓰는 팁(체감 큰 것만)마감 청소 루틴: 조리 끝나면 물기 → 마른걸레 순서로 한 번씩. 물자국이 확 줄어요.가열 전 바닥 물기 제거: 냄비 바닥이 젖은 채로 올리면 얼룩/열자국이 생기기 쉬움.상판 긁힘 방지: 바닥 거친 주물/코팅 벗겨진 팬은 조심(밀지 말고 들어서 이동).2) LG 빌트인 식기세척기(상단 컨트롤, ThinQ) 리뷰사진상 컨트롤이 상단에 숨겨지는 타입이라 문 닫으면 전면이 정말 깔끔합니다(주방 ‘면’이 깨끗해짐).좋았던 점설거지 시간/정신적 피로가 크게 줄어듦: 이사 후 새 가전에서 체감효과 1~2순위가 보통 식세기예요.빌트인이라 동선이 좋아짐: 싱크 바로 옆/아래에서 “헹굼→투입→끝”이 되니 주방이 정돈돼 보여요.모드 선택이 직관적(보임): 자동/강력/조용/살균/고온건조/예약/헹굼류가 보이는데,평소엔 자동,기름기 많으면 강력,밤엔 조용,위생/도마·유아식기 느낌이면 살균/고온건조이런 식으로 쓰면 됩니다.에너지효율 1등급 스티커 확인됨: 장기 사용 비용/전기요금 면에서도 심리적 만족이 큼.아쉬울 수 있는 점플라스틱 건조는 한계: 젖어 남는 경우가 많아요(재질 특성).적재가 결과를 좌우: “대충 넣으면 대충 나온다”가 식세기 진리입니다. (팁 아래 참고)필터/도어 하단 관리 필요: 주 1회만 습관 들이면 냄새/성능 이슈가 거의 사라져요.결과 확 좋아지는 적재/관리 팁그릇은 ‘물길’이 생기게 세워 넣기: 겹치면 그 부분만 덜 닦입니다.오목한 그릇은 물 고이지 않게 각도 주기: 컵/뚜껑류가 특히 중요.세제는 “많이”가 아니라 “맞게”: 과다 투입하면 오히려 잔여물/미끌거림이 생길 수 있어요.필터 청소: 최소 주 1회(가볍게 헹굼). 기름진 메뉴가 많으면 더 자주.건조 마무리: 끝나고 10분 뒤 문을 살짝 열어두면(가능한 구조라면) 잔열로 건조가 확 좋아집니다.

Sentence (English): Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving.
Comments (English): 1) LG Induction (White Glass) Review. What I Liked. Kitchen Interior Finish: The white top matches the color of the tiles and countertop, making the appliance look like furniture. This is especially effective when the top is minimal, as shown in the photo. Difficulty in Cleaning the Top: Unlike gas ranges, which require disassembling the burner and digging into grease, the one-touch wipe design makes maintenance easy. The touch panel is located on the front: Easy to reach while cooking (on the front bar), making it easy to use. ThinQ Integration (Visible): The Wi-Fi/ThinQ indicator allows you to check the device's status and sync some settings (range may vary by model). Cons: White glass doesn't "invisible," but rather "visible." Oil splatters are less noticeable, but water marks and matte stains can sometimes remain (remedy with a rinse). Check pot/pan compatibility: Cookware with weak magnetic bases may not heat up or cause malfunctions. Fan noise/relay noise: Fan noise/clicking noise at high power is often normal. Useful tips (only those that are noticeable). Final cleaning routine: After cooking, wipe with a damp cloth, then a dry cloth. This significantly reduces water stains. Remove moisture from the bottom before heating: If you place a pot on a wet bottom, it's easy for stains/heat marks to form. Preventing scratches on the cooktop: Be careful with rough cast iron or pans with peeling coatings (lift, don't push). 2) LG built-in dishwasher (top control, ThinQ) review. The controls are hidden at the top, so when the door is closed, the front is incredibly clean (making the kitchen surface cleaner). Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. Normally, Auto, Powerful for oily items, Quiet at night, and Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying for hygiene/baby tableware. This is how it works. Energy efficiency rating verified: Long-term usage costs and electricity bills are also highly satisfying. Some drawbacks: Plastic dryers have limitations: They often leave behind moisture (due to the material's characteristics). Filter cleaning: At least once a week (lightly rinse), more often if you have a lot of oily items. Drying finish: After the machine is finished, leave the door slightly open for 10 minutes (if possible) to allow the residual heat to drain, which will significantly improve drying.

This is especially effective when the top is minimal, as shown in the photo. Difficulty in Cleaning the Top: Unlike gas ranges, which require disassembling the burner and digging into grease, the one-touch wipe design makes maintenance easy. The touch panel is located on the front: Easy to reach while cooking (on the front bar), making it easy to use. ThinQ Integration (Visible): The Wi-Fi/ThinQ indicator allows you to check the device's status and sync some settings (range may vary by model). Cons: White glass doesn't "invisible," but rather "visible." Oil splatters are less noticeable, but water marks and matte stains can sometimes remain (remedy with a rinse). Check pot/pan compatibility: Cookware with weak magnetic bases may not heat up or cause malfunctions. Fan noise/relay noise: Fan noise/clicking noise at high power is often normal. Useful tips (only those that are noticeable). Final cleaning routine: After cooking, wipe with a damp cloth, then a dry cloth. This significantly reduces water stains. Remove moisture from the bottom before heating: If you place a pot on a wet bottom, it's easy for stains/heat marks to form. Preventing scratches on the cooktop: Be careful with rough cast iron or pans with peeling coatings (lift, don't push). 2) LG built-in dishwasher (top control, ThinQ) review. The controls are hidden at the top, so when the door is closed, the front is incredibly clean (making the kitchen surface cleaner). Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. Built-in design improves accessibility: The rinse cycle is right next to/under the sink, making the kitchen look more organized. The mode selection is intuitive: Auto/Powerful/Quiet/Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying/Scheduling/Rinse. Normally, Auto, Powerful for oily items, Quiet at night, and Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying for hygiene/baby tableware. This is how it works. Energy efficiency rating verified: Long-term usage costs and electricity bills are also highly satisfying. Some drawbacks: Plastic dryers have limitations: They often leave behind moisture (due to the material's characteristics). Loading determines results: "Instantly put in, instantly come out" is the truth with dishwashers (see tips below). Filter/door bottom maintenance is necessary: Develop a weekly habit and odor/performance issues will virtually disappear. Loading/maintenance tips for significantly improved results: Stack dishes upright to create a "water path": Overlapping dishes will require less cleaning. Angle concave dishes to prevent water pooling: This is especially important for cups and lids. Use just the right amount of detergent: Overloading can actually cause residue and slipperiness. Filter cleaning: At least once a week (lightly rinse), more often if you have a lot of oily items. Drying finish: After the machine is finished, leave the door slightly open for 10 minutes (if possible) to allow the residual heat to drain, which will significantly improve drying.
Comments (Original): 1) LG 인덕션(화이트 글라스) 리뷰좋았던 점주방 인테리어 완성도: 화이트 상판이 상부 타일/상판 색이랑 톤이 맞아서 “가전이 가구처럼” 보여요. 특히 사진처럼 상부가 미니멀하면 효과가 큼.상판 청소 난이도↓: 가스레인지처럼 버너 분해/기름때 파고드는 구조가 아니라, 한 번에 쓱 닦이는 타입이라 관리가 편함.터치 패널이 전면: 조리하면서 손이 닿기 쉬운 위치(전면 바)라 사용성이 좋아요.ThinQ 연동(보임): Wi-Fi/ThinQ 표기가 있어, 기기 상태 확인/일부 설정 연동이 가능한 쪽(모델별 범위 차이 있음).아쉬울 수 있는 점화이트 글라스는 얼룩이 ‘안 보이는 게 아니라 다르게 보임’: 기름 튐은 덜 티나도 물자국/무광 얼룩이 남을 때가 있어요(헹주로 마감하면 해결).냄비/팬 호환 체크 필요: 바닥 자성이 약한 조리도구는 화력이 안 나오거나 오류가 날 수 있음.팬 소음/릴레이 소리: 고출력에서 “팬 도는 소리/딸깍” 소리는 정상 범주인 경우가 많아요.잘 쓰는 팁(체감 큰 것만)마감 청소 루틴: 조리 끝나면 물기 → 마른걸레 순서로 한 번씩. 물자국이 확 줄어요.가열 전 바닥 물기 제거: 냄비 바닥이 젖은 채로 올리면 얼룩/열자국이 생기기 쉬움.상판 긁힘 방지: 바닥 거친 주물/코팅 벗겨진 팬은 조심(밀지 말고 들어서 이동).2) LG 빌트인 식기세척기(상단 컨트롤, ThinQ) 리뷰사진상 컨트롤이 상단에 숨겨지는 타입이라 문 닫으면 전면이 정말 깔끔합니다(주방 ‘면’이 깨끗해짐).좋았던 점설거지 시간/정신적 피로가 크게 줄어듦: 이사 후 새 가전에서 체감효과 1~2순위가 보통 식세기예요.빌트인이라 동선이 좋아짐: 싱크 바로 옆/아래에서 “헹굼→투입→끝”이 되니 주방이 정돈돼 보여요.모드 선택이 직관적(보임): 자동/강력/조용/살균/고온건조/예약/헹굼류가 보이는데,평소엔 자동,기름기 많으면 강력,밤엔 조용,위생/도마·유아식기 느낌이면 살균/고온건조이런 식으로 쓰면 됩니다.에너지효율 1등급 스티커 확인됨: 장기 사용 비용/전기요금 면에서도 심리적 만족이 큼.아쉬울 수 있는 점플라스틱 건조는 한계: 젖어 남는 경우가 많아요(재질 특성).적재가 결과를 좌우: “대충 넣으면 대충 나온다”가 식세기 진리입니다. (팁 아래 참고)필터/도어 하단 관리 필요: 주 1회만 습관 들이면 냄새/성능 이슈가 거의 사라져요.결과 확 좋아지는 적재/관리 팁그릇은 ‘물길’이 생기게 세워 넣기: 겹치면 그 부분만 덜 닦입니다.오목한 그릇은 물 고이지 않게 각도 주기: 컵/뚜껑류가 특히 중요.세제는 “많이”가 아니라 “맞게”: 과다 투입하면 오히려 잔여물/미끌거림이 생길 수 있어요.필터 청소: 최소 주 1회(가볍게 헹굼). 기름진 메뉴가 많으면 더 자주.건조 마무리: 끝나고 10분 뒤 문을 살짝 열어두면(가능한 구조라면) 잔열로 건조가 확 좋아집니다.

This is especially effective when the top is minimal, as shown in the photo. Difficulty in Cleaning the Top: Unlike gas ranges, which require disassembling the burner and digging into grease, the one-touch wipe design makes maintenance easy. The touch panel is located on the front: Easy to reach while cooking (on the front bar), making it easy to use. ThinQ Integration (Visible): The Wi-Fi/ThinQ indicator allows you to check the device's status and sync some settings (range may vary by model). Cons: White glass doesn't "invisible," but rather "visible." Oil splatters are less noticeable, but water marks and matte stains can sometimes remain (remedy with a rinse). Check pot/pan compatibility: Cookware with weak magnetic bases may not heat up or cause malfunctions. Fan noise/relay noise: Fan noise/clicking noise at high power is often normal. Useful tips (only those that are noticeable). Final cleaning routine: After cooking, wipe with a damp cloth, then a dry cloth. This significantly reduces water stains. Remove moisture from the bottom before heating: If you place a pot on a wet bottom, it's easy for stains/heat marks to form. Preventing scratches on the cooktop: Be careful with rough cast iron or pans with peeling coatings (lift, don't push). 2) LG built-in dishwasher (top control, ThinQ) review. The controls are hidden at the top, so when the door is closed, the front is incredibly clean (making the kitchen surface cleaner). Pros: Significantly reduced dishwashing time/mental fatigue: The dishwasher is usually the first or second most noticeable benefit of a new appliance after moving. Built-in design improves accessibility: The rinse cycle is right next to/under the sink, making the kitchen look more organized. The mode selection is intuitive: Auto/Powerful/Quiet/Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying/Scheduling/Rinse. Normally, Auto, Powerful for oily items, Quiet at night, and Sterilization/High-Temperature Drying for hygiene/baby tableware. This is how it works. Energy efficiency rating verified: Long-term usage costs and electricity bills are also highly satisfying. Some drawbacks: Plastic dryers have limitations: They often leave behind moisture (due to the material's characteristics). Loading determines results: "Instantly put in, instantly come out" is the truth with dishwashers (see tips below). Filter/door bottom maintenance is necessary: Develop a weekly habit and odor/performance issues will virtually disappear. Loading/maintenance tips for significantly improved results: Stack dishes upright to create a "water path": Overlapping dishes will require less cleaning. Angle concave dishes to prevent water pooling: This is especially important for cups and lids. Use just the right amount of detergent: Overloading can actually cause residue and slipperiness. Filter cleaning: At least once a week (lightly rinse), more often if you have a lot of oily items. Drying finish: After the machine is finished, leave the door slightly open for 10 minutes (if possible) to allow the residual heat to drain, which will significantly improve drying.

(팁 아래 참고)필터/도어 하단 관리 필요: 주 1회만 습관 들이면 냄새/성능 이슈가 거의 사라져요.결과 확 좋아지는 적재/관리 팁그릇은 ‘물길’이 생기게 세워 넣기: 겹치면 그 부분만 덜 닦입니다.오목한 그릇은 물 고이지 않게 각도 주기: 컵/뚜껑류가 특히 중요.세제는 “많이”가 아니라 “맞게”: 과다 투입하면 오히려 잔여물/미끌거림이 생길 수 있어요.필터 청소: 최소 주 1회(가볍게 헹굼). 기름진 메뉴가 많으면 더 자주.건조 마무리: 끝나고 10분 뒤 문을 살짝 열어두면(가능한 구조라면) 잔열로 건조가 확 좋아집니다.

This means it's fully integrated with a complete kitchen cabinet front across its entire height. Before ordering, please measure to ensure the 86cm height fits under your kitchen worktop! We installed the dishwasher ourselves using online DIY video tutorials. A rubber skirt is included for reduced noise. This must be attached before the cabinet front is mounted. This dishwasher no longer has push buttons, but rather easy-to-clean sensor controls. A cutlery drawer was important to me when searching for a dishwasher. Each piece is cleaned individually, and if you pay attention to the order when loading, unloading is super quick. The upper rack can be easily raised or lowered using the side levers, allowing even very large plates to be placed in the lower rack. The extra 5 cm of height inside is really noticeable. You can fold various items in or out of the baskets, such as pots or long-stemmed glasses. There are many programs, which are well and clearly described in the instruction manual and also take personal opinions and preferences into account. I was also impressed by the projection display on the floor. It shows the remaining time until the program is finished. And there's light inside. What a luxury! (Sometimes I just open the door as I walk by and enjoy it □□) Plastic bowls and the like also come out looking great, thanks to the zeolite drying technology. After the dishwasher is installed, be sure to take a look at the instruction manual (about halfway through the booklet) and program your personal settings: water hardness, which then regulates the rinse aid dosage, or, for example, beep tones (yes/no), etc. With such long-term purchases, I think more carefully about WHAT I buy. And sometimes a product really excites me, like this GS.
Comments (Original): [ BOSCH SBV 6 ZCX 16E ] || ---------------- || Bosch-Geschirrspüler BOSCH SBV 6 ZCX 16E Serie 6, extra hoch 86cm (5 cm höher als Standardhöhe)Vollintegrierbar. Bedeutet mit kompletter Küchenmöbel-Front über die gesamte Höhe.Vor der Bestellung ausmessen, ob die Höhe 86cm unter die Küchenarbeitsplatte geht !!!Wir haben den GS selbst eingebaut mit Hilfe von Handwerker-Video-Anleitungen im Internet.Es liegt eine Gummischürze für leiseren Geräuschpegel bei. Die muss angebracht werden, bevor die Möbelfront montiert wird.Dieser GS hat keine Drucktasten mehr, sondern reinigungsfreundliche Sensor-Bedien-Tasten.Mir war bei der Suche nach einem GS ein Besteck-Schublade wichtig. Es wird jedes Teil einzeln gereinigt und ist, wenn man beim Einräumen auf die Sortierung achtet, super schnell auszuräumen .Der Oberkorb kann mittels seitlichen Hebeln ganz einfach höher oder niedriger gestellt werden, so dass unten auch die ganz großen Teller einsortiert werden können. Hier machen sich die höheren 5 cm im Innenraum bemerkbar.In den Körben kann man verschiedene Teile ein- oder ausklappen, z.B. f. Töpfe oderlangstielige Gläser.Es gibt viele Programme, die in der Bedienungsanleitung gut und übersichtlich beschrieben sind und auch persönliche Meinungen und Vorlieben berücksichtigt.Mich hat auch die Projektions-Anzeige auf dem Boden begeistert. Hier wird die Restzeit angezeigt, bis das Programm fertig ist.Und es gibt Licht im Innenraum. Was für ein Luxus ! (Manchmal mache ich die Klappe einfach so im Vorbeigehen auf und freue mich  □□)Kunststoffschüsseln &Co. sehen auch gut aus, dank der Zeolith-Trockentechnologie.Nachdem der GS eingebaut ist, unbedingt noch die Bedienungs-Anleitung in die Hand nehmen ( ca. in der Mitte des Heftes ) und die persönliche Einstellung programmieren: Wasserhärte, die dann wieder die Zugabe von Klarspüler regelt  oder z.B. Pieps-Töne Ja/nein  ….  usw.Bei solchen langfristigen Anschaffungen denke ich gründlicher nach, WAS ich kaufe. Und manchmal begeistert mich auch ein Produkt, so wie dieser GS

Sentence (English): The Bosch 800 series dishwasher's cleaning ability is fabulous, however, getting to know how to work the machine was frustrating.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 Series Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 800 series dishwasher's cleaning ability is fabulous, however, getting to know how to work the machine was frustrating. The buttons on my machine didn't work the way the manual stated, and even online tutorial YouTube videos were not helpful on running the first load. The machine kept defaulting back to the "quick wash" setting and we could not get it to go to any other setting until we just let it do a quick wash, then the machine's settings worked by touching the setting buttons the way the manual said they would. Next, after ordering the hard water kit and finding I needed dishwasher salt to soften the water, I could not get the machine to the settings for the salt. I had to download the ap on my phone and adjust it from there. Sometimes, I think these appliances are engineered to be so smart that people who are not very saavy with technology end up frustrated. Over all, I am very satisfied with the cleaning ability of the machine, which is why I bought it.

My fault for pushing wrong/too hard, but it should be strong enough to resist that. Second, while this isn't the top of their line and can't be expected to have all the bells and whistles, I regret that they made it necessary to rely on the app for delayed start. These are minor quibbles. Everything else about the machine is well conceived and well made. I haven't had use yet for the option to raise only one side of the top rack, but I appreciate the option—which other makers don't allow. One small nice detail among many.

Sentence (English): As a dual-income couple, we desperately wanted to escape the dishwashing hell, so we decided to opt for the Samsung Bespoke AI Built-in model.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Reviews: A Vertically Elevated Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || As a dual-income couple, we desperately wanted to escape the dishwashing hell, so we decided to opt for the Samsung Bespoke AI Built-in model. Thanks to the neat installation by Coupang's expert installation team, our kitchen interior has become much more luxurious. Seeing the perfect fit with our cabinetry, I realized why it's called Bespoke. My favorite feature is the AI-customized washing function. It automatically detects the level of dirt in the dishes and adjusts the washing time and water temperature, eliminating the need for me to manually adjust the settings. It's incredibly smart because it integrates with the SmartThings app, allowing me to check and control the remaining time even when I'm away. Unlike the high-temperature drying of conventional models, this model uses a hot air dryer, eliminating the worry of plastic containers warping. After the wash is complete, the door automatically opens to evaporate any remaining moisture, and the fluffy, soft texture of the dishes when I take them out in the morning is truly impressive. It's so quiet that even late at night, you can barely hear it in the living room. The internal shelf layout is optimized for Korean tableware, allowing for efficient storage of deep pots and large plates, adding to its practicality.

Sentence (English): Before we replaced our old dishwasher, I was doing most of the dishes by hand.
Comments (English): [ Love everything about this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Before we replaced our old dishwasher, I was doing most of the dishes by hand. Since we have gotten this Samsung, I have completely changed my dishwashing routine. I am continually amazed at how effectively this thing cleans even dried-on debris. I don't bother wiping anything before putting it in the dishwasher; if anything, it gets a quick rinse and a scrape to remove leftover food before going in the washer. With just two people in my household, we run the cycle once a day at most, and some of those dishes that get washed at the end of the day have been in there since breakfast. Pie pans that had a brown patina from frequent baking return to their chrome color after just a few trips in this thing. I won't say everything comes out clean, but it's a rare instance when a dish or a pot has to be hand washed after spending time in this thing. I went shopping just last week to replace a dishwasher in a rental that my son owns and was struck by the difference between this Samsung and the models I was looking at. All metal tub and door sheathing is totally worth it. And the versatility of the three drawers lets you really load a lot of dishes in ways that ensures they will come out clean. And the noise level is so low, you can barely detect that it is running until it discharges the dirty water down the drain.I have a kitchen full of Samsung appliances, and I have had no problems with any of them. I got hooked on the SmartThings app that connects them all, and it has been very useful in reminding me when to perform preventive maintenance to keep everything humming along.

Overall, this dishwasher is an excellent mix of beauty, quiet performance, and real cleaning power. Sentence (English): Have had this unit about one month and so far it has been fantastic.
Comments (English): [ Our first Bosch appliance ] || ---------------- || Have had this unit about one month and so far it has been fantastic. No complaints at all about how it cleans -- we've loaded it up with some rather dirty pans, just to see what it can do, and so far, it has handled everything we placed inside. We are beginning to enjoy the small, top drawer for silverware. They get very clean, but the best part is that unloading is super quick and easy. Scoop them up and drop them in the silverware drawer. Also (! ) it leaves extra room in the bottom drawer for larger pans and more dishes. We did not expect this benefit at all as we have not owned any previous DW that included this feature. So, a very nice surprise. Adding drying aid gives glasses the best look. Super clear/clean, even with drying aid, our old DW still couldn't give them this "new from the store" look.

Sentence (English): Installation from Home Depot was quick and easy, at least for me.
Comments (English): Installation from Home Depot was quick and easy, at least for me. I was afraid it would take hours but the tech was here when he said he would be, pulled out the old DW, and installed this one in maybe 30 minutes. So glad I didn't do it myself. We've had the Bosch for about one month now and so far, no problems at all. We appreciate the third drawer at the top for silverware over the standup boxes in the bottom like our old Kitchen Aide. It leaves so much more room for items in the bottom drawer. Cleaning is very good so far. Adding drying agent seems to really help glassware to emerge super clear and spotless. The previous Kitchen Aide was maybe quieter, but I don't think that is true.

You dont know if the dishes in the dishwasher are clean or dirty you have to open it up and check. Our other model had a green light. I would have prefered in the design to include a green light to indicate when the dishes are done. You have a red light to indicate the washer is on then it just shuts off. It would have made more sense to include a green light to go on to indicate the dishes are clean and the cycle is over. So now my kids are constantly opening and closing the dishwasher to see if the dishes are clean or dirty over and over and over again.

Comments (English): [ Review of the #1 model ] || ---------------- || To be honest, we're Samsung fans. We've only used Samsung since the 1980s, but recently... Sentence (English): I bought the Bosch Series 6 SMS6ZCW10E dishwasher with Zeolith technology on the recommendation of a family member who had already had a very positive experience with the brand.
Comments (English): [ Excellent product and service ] || ---------------- || I bought the Bosch Series 6 SMS6ZCW10E dishwasher with Zeolith technology on the recommendation of a family member who had already had a very positive experience with the brand. I would highlight both the product quality and the professionalism of the service. The delivery was punctual, and the technicians were very efficient, polite, and attentive, answering all my questions with kindness. As for the dishwasher itself, I especially appreciate its modern white design, its low noise level, and its large interior capacity. The third VarioDrawer cutlery tray is very practical and allows for better use of space. The baskets are easy to adjust and adapt very well to different types of dishes. The drying is truly excellent thanks to the Zeolith system, even with plastics, and the results are always sparkling clean. At home, it's become a running joke: when we don't hear anything, we say, "That's normal, Bosch is doing laundry today." That sums it all up. Overall, it's been a very positive experience from purchase to daily use, and I would definitely trust the brand again. Perhaps the information available on the website regarding the country of origin of the models could be improved, as this is something I'm interested in knowing as a consumer. Also, the model I was looking for wasn't initially available, but fortunately it became available again a few days later and I was able to purchase it without any problems. My experience has been very positive and I have no significant complaints.
